propositions: Three existing auto-bug filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, reconciler conflict filer) lack consistent dedup patterns, causing duplicate filings and spam from single flakes.

Heartbeat filer must implement 2-consecutive-red threshold by querying workflow run history; binding-drift filer requires no threshold due to persistent state semantics, while conflict filer requires per-conflict SHA1 dedup tag.

All three filers must use templated bug creation with stable dedup tags, daily accumulation-comment markers, abort-if-empty-detail behavior, and detected_by stamping to conform to a documented bug-creation contract.

Recovery logic diverges by filer: heartbeat and binding-drift use existing auto-close on green via 'rebar transition open closed --force-close'; conflict filer must leave close to agents (no auto-close) with rationale documented in audit table.
Workflow run-history queries (heartbeat only) and accumulation-comment dedup (all three) use the ticket store as durable state; no new state store is introduced.
